pageProps.content: ## Review We visited after hearing it was known as a great dessert spot. The system was to wait and get seated at a table, then order at the counter using that table number. Not knowing this, we went straight to the counter, figured it out on the spot, ordered with an empty table number, and quickly took that seat. The person taking our order was Korean here too, so we were able to order comfortably in Korean. Probably because it was a weekday, many people seemed to be working or having external meetings. There were also outdoor tables, and I thought if I lived here, it would be the perfect spot to work leisurely outside on a day off. ## Pictures
